summary: Tested Heart Rate feature: backend /api/ws/hr WebSocket (auth + telemetry ingestion) and frontend rendering on admin dashboard + live overlay update. All 6 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend HR controls render correctly and overlay updates live from a JS-driven /api/ws/hr sender.

backend.test_overlay_state_has_hr_keys: PASS - hr_bpm & hr_connected keys present in GET /api/overlay/state
backend.test_ws_hr_authenticated_updates_telemet: PASS - bpm 72 -> 145 propagated; 9999 clamped to 300; -50 clamped to 0; hr_status connected=false resets to bpm=0
backend.test_ws_hr_disconnect_resets: PASS - closing HR socket resets hr_connected=false, hr_bpm=0
backend.test_overlay_ws_receives_hr_frame: PASS - overlay WS first frame includes hr_bpm=111 & hr_connected=true

frontend.admin_hr_connect_button: PASS - data-testid=hr-connect-button renders 'HEART RATE' and is enabled (Web Bluetooth pairing NOT auto-tested by design)
frontend.overlay_hr_tile_initial: PASS - data-testid=overlay-hr present; overlay-hr-value shows '--' initially
frontend.overlay_hr_live_update: PASS - Pushing bpm=123 via JS-opened /api/ws/hr updates value to '123BPM'; then 88 -> '88BPM'; red HR sparkline animates
frontend.overlay_hr_reset_on_close: PASS - Closing HR sender WS reverts overlay-hr-value to '--BPM'

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/ws/hr is registered on the FastAPI app directly (not api_router). This works because the prefix /api is included in the path, but consider consistency with other WS routes.
server.py has grown to 973 lines - consider splitting hub/telemetry, websockets, auth, and audit routes into separate modules for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HR feature verified end-to-end (backend WS auth/clamp/reset + overlay live update). Web Bluetooth pairing on admin dashboard cannot be exercised headlessly - only render/enabled checks. Use test_hr_websocket.py for regression.
